部品「アニメーター」の「状態とルール」に入れると、ルールが上から調べられ、当たっ: Put this in the "States and rules" field of an Animator component: the rules are checked from the top, and the clip of the matching row's state plays. Watch it work in the "Animation" tab
ルールの条件で使う名前 (speed・grounded・jump …)。スクリプ: The name used in rule conditions (speed, grounded, jump ...). Scripts set the value by this name
数: 小数 / 整数 / 真偽: 0 か 1 / トリガー: 立てると、それを使: Number: decimal / Integer / Bool: 0 or 1 / Trigger: once set, it clears when a rule using it matches (or after 0.2 s)
ゲームが始まったときの値 (真偽は 0 / 1。トリガーは使わない): The value when the game starts (0 / 1 for bools; not used for triggers)
ルールの「元」「先」で使う名前 (Idle・Move・Jump …): The name used in a rule's "From" and "To" (Idle, Move, Jump ...)
この状態で流すクリップの名前 (アニメーターのモデルのクリップ): The name of the clip to play in this state (a clip of the animator's model)
外すと 1 回流して最後のコマで止まります (条件の ended が真になる): When off, it plays once and stops on the last frame (the condition "ended" becomes true)
自由: 全部のルールを調べる / 自分のルールだけ: 元がこの状態のルールと ⚡: Free: check every rule / Own rules only: only rules whose From is this state, and ⚡ rules (a jump does not go back to walking midway) / Own rules until it ends: own rules until the clip ends, then all (attacks, landing)
今この状態のときだけ調べる (状態の名前)。空: どこでも: Checked only while in this state (a state name). Empty: anywhere
真のとき移る。C++ と同じ書き方: speed > 0.1 / jump /: Moves when true. Written like C++: speed > 0.1 / jump / grounded && !attack / t > 0.5 (progress in the current state, 0..1) / ended (a one-shot clip finished, or a loop went around once). Empty: always
移る先の状態の名前: The name of the state to move to
今の姿勢から先の状態へ、この秒数かけて混ぜる: Blend from the current pose into the new state over this many seconds
今の状態の出口が「自分のルールだけ」でも調べる (死ぬ・やられる): Checked even when the current state's exit is "Own rules only" (dying, getting hit)
先が今の状態と同じでも、始めから流し直す (同じ攻撃を続ける): Plays from the start even if the target is the current state (repeating the same attack)
ルールの条件で使う値。スクリプトが入れます: Values used in rule conditions. Scripts set them
毎フレーム上から調べて、元が合って条件が真の最初の 1 行で移ります。上ほど強い: Checked from the top every frame; the first row whose From matches and whose condition is true decides. Higher rows win
